sources.title: Directive 2001/83/EC — Title VIII Advertising
sources.note: Member-state implementation and national codes still apply; DE/FR packs or stubs capture national deltas.

medical.title: Advertising only for authorized medicines / indications
medical.check_prompt: Using supplied SmPC / authorized indications for the EU markets in scope, flag promotion of unauthorized medicines or indications. Missing SmPC → [GAP].

medical.title: Essential information accompanies advertising
medical.check_prompt: Check that essential information compatible with the SmPC (as implemented nationally) is not omitted when the format requires it. Format unclear → [GAP].

medical.title: Substantiation of claims
medical.check_prompt: Flag claims that lack a clear scientific reference in the supplied materials. Do not invent PubMed citations.

legal.title: No advertising to the general public for prescription medicines
legal.check_prompt: If audience is HCP-only but channel/copy would reach the public (open web, consumer tone), flag public-advertising risk under Title VIII principles.

legal.title: Gifts, inducements, and hospitality language
legal.check_prompt: Flag copy that offers prohibited inducements or hospitality inconsistent with EFPIA-style restrictions. Ambiguity → escalate to compliance, do not clear.

regulatory.title: Member-state overlay not ignored
regulatory.check_prompt: If jurisdictions include specific member states (e.g. DE, FR), require those packs or stubs to be loaded. EU-central pack alone is not enough for national launch materials.

regulatory.title: Cross-border digital promotion
regulatory.check_prompt: For digital HCP promotion accessible across EU, flag missing geo/access controls or country-specific prescribing information when materials claim multi-country use.
